body:
## Problem

The insight editor saves the insight when a user selects a new chart type. The user does not click Save. A [session recording of the bug](https://us.posthog.com/project/2/replay/01a0cf52-45d5-7a7a-b7d5-d95a108aa417) shows the exact sequence: the user picks a chart type, and the editor exits edit mode and shows an "Insight updated" message within one second. This happens twice in the recording.

## Changes

- `isInsightSceneInstance` (`frontend/src/scenes/insights/insightDataLogic.tsx`) now compares `insightId` and `dashboardId` from `insightSceneLogic` instead of its `insightLogicRef`.
- A listener rebuilds and mounts a new logic instance to set `insightLogicRef`. This work can still be in progress right after the user opens the editor.
- The same action that matches the URL writes `insightId` and `dashboardId`. These values do not lag behind the ref.
- Before this fix, a chart-type click during that gap passed the guard. The editor then sent a PATCH request before the ref caught up.

## How did you test this code?

- Added a regression test to `insightDataLogic.test.ts` that sets a stale `insightLogicRef` while `insightId` and `dashboardId` are already correct. The test fails against the code before this fix, with the same symptom as the bug report. It passes after the fix.
- Ran three test files locally: `insightDataLogic.test.ts`, `insightSceneLogic.test.ts`, and `insightLogic.test.ts`. All 127 tests passed.
- Did not run a manual repro in a browser. No browser was available in this sandbox. Checked the [session recording of the bug](https://us.posthog.com/project/2/replay/01a0cf52-45d5-7a7a-b7d5-d95a108aa417) instead. An AI summary of the recording confirmed two facts: the user did not click Save, and the editor redirected automatically right after the chart-type selection.
- Human note: I tried to repro this in quite a few ways but wasn't able to, it appears to be a race condition that's difficult to trigger, however we can try this fix and see if it continues to occur or not.

## Release status

- [x] No feature flag controls this change

## Automatic notifications

- [ ] Publish to changelog?

## Docs update

None.

## 🤖 Agent context

**Autonomy:** Human-driven (agent-assisted)

**Agent:** Claude Code, Sonnet 5

Investigated a Slack bug report using PostHog session-recording and event data. Found the session that reproduces the bug. Confirmed the click sequence with the replay AI summarizer. Traced the staleness bug in the guard through `insightDataLogic.tsx` and `insightSceneLogic.tsx`.

Skills invoked: `/writing-tests` (extended the existing `persistDisplayOptions` describe block instead of adding a new one; the new test states a concrete regression, and it fails against the code before this fix), `/writing-pr-descriptions`, `/writing-simplified-technical-english` (rewrote this description).

No duplicate: searched open PRs for `isInsightSceneInstance`, `insightLogicRef`, "chart type autosave", and `persistDisplayOptions`. No open PR covers this fix.
title: fix(insights): stop the insight editor auto-saving on a chart-type change
